easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: A strong, stable starting position. Mistakes cost points but rarely sink you.

medium.label: Medium
medium.blurb: Real rivals and real risks. Bad choices can lose points and shake your empire.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: High risk, high reward. The biggest scores are possible here, and so are fast collapses.

collapsePenalty.explain: If your empire collapses, you lose half of your points (at least 10).
